question: Identify a factor that does NOT determine the temperature of ocean waters.

options.text: Unequal distribution of land and water

solution:
The correct answer is __**Longitude**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Longitude** does not determine the temperature of ocean waters.
 
• The temperature of ocean waters is influenced by factors such as **unequal distribution of land and water, latitude, and ocean currents**.
 
• **Latitude** **affects temperature** as it determines the angle of the sun's rays and length of daylight.
 
• **Ocean currents** can** carry warm or cold water** across different parts of the ocean, affecting local temperatures.
 
• **Unequal distribution of land and water** influences the temperature due to different heat capacities of land and water bodies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Latitude** is a geographical coordinate that specifies the **north–south position** of a point on the Earth's surface.
 
• **Longitude** is a geographical coordinate that specifies the **east–west position** of a point on the Earth's surface but does not influence temperature.
 
• **Ocean currents** are continuous, directed movements of seawater generated by forces such as wind, temperature differences, and salinity gradients.
 
• The **unequal distribution of land and water** leads to varying heating and cooling rates, affecting the climate and temperature of adjacent ocean waters.
